# LightLattices.jl

Construct lattices and clusters, attach species, and select or combine physical collections.
Start with [Basics](@ref manual-basics) and [Examples](@ref manual-examples),
then explore [Physical Collections](@ref manual-physical-collections)
and their underlying [Node Collections](@ref manual-node-collections).
